pages.title: Thermoelectric Generator
pages.text: A furnace wrapped in thermocouples: the heat of ordinary fuel, turned straight into current by the Seebeck effect. Humble - and the first power any laboratory has.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Burns $(item)coal$(), $(item)charcoal$(), $(item)coal blocks$(), $(item)blaze rods$() and $(item)dried kelp blocks$() for power - no research needed. Enough to run the Casimir Vacuum Press and build the Zero-Point Energy Extractor.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (1 item and 0 fluid inputs, 0 and 0 outputs).
